name: Shenzhou 24
location_str: Launch Area 91 (SLS-1 / 921) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: Even at this height there are faint wisps of atmosphere. They slowly drag satellites down, so anything here needs an occasional push to stay up.
slot_a_text: Shenzhou 24 will be the 24th flight of the Shenzhou program. The first astronaut from Pakistan, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, will fly on this on a short duration mission, with Chinese astronaut Zhu Yangzhu of Shenzhou 23 to undergo a year long expedition and stay on the CSS in exchange.
slot_b_text: Shenzhou 24 carries a crew of three: commander Tang Hongbo and operators Muhammad Zeeshan Ali and Wu Yi.

program_description: The Shenzhou program is a crewed spaceflight initiative by China. The program put the first Chinese citizen, Yang Liwei, into orbit on 15 October 2003.
rocket_fact: The Long March 2F is nicknamed 'Shenjian' (Divine Arrow) and is used for China's crewed missions.
